note: Family-owned park south-east of Clinton near Truman Lake, run by the same owners for 20+ years; also rents cabins, tiny homes and houses and offers storage. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026): 137 FHU sites (20/30/50A), shower house, laundry, pool, store; no rates anywhere, stay requests only after an account login. Drop candidate: no posted price (RV Life $$ the only price indicator), long-stay test 2 fails, and imagery shows nearly every site filled with long-term-looking rigs.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (private, long-stay / price): (a) PRICE - the operator site posts no nightly, weekly or monthly rate anywhere (home, RV Sites, Amenities, About); the only price indicator is the stored RV Life $$ tier; gateways.py not needed for an unpriced park; Good Sam directory says not a GS Park (stored false), military true (directory) left as stored. (b) BOOKING - 'Request a Stay' leads to 'Sign in to request a stay' (an account login), so a traveller cannot see a price or availability without registering (memory: login to see rates = drop unless the site posts prices + phone; it posts no prices). (c) LONG-STAY five tests: (1) no nightly price posted - FAIL; (2) no nightly price and no open booking engine - FAIL; (3) marketing is 'for RV travelers, families, and long-term guests', with storage, rental homes and an owner portal - weak; (4) one-night occupancy check NOT POSSIBLE (login wall); Esri imagery (leaf-off) shows essentially every pad in the east rows occupied, many by rigs with skirting/sheds that look permanently set - suggests well under 1 in 10 sold nightly; (5) not checked. Report for AWH; presence itself is fine (own site, Google 4.5 stars, 180 reviews).
Pin: stored 38.2995,-93.7403 is the office/shop by SE 91 Rd; the RV rows run 150-300 m east of it (centre roughly 38.2995,-93.7380, ~200 m). Under the 250 m threshold on this estimate, optional.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: two ponds south of the office, ~0.3 acre and ~1.3 acres (under ~5 acres, no pond-view), well away from the RV rows.
